change: Typed construction-time page advice for the generic MoE RAM cache and native placement store; --ram-page-policy huge|system in the native CLI and diagnostic benchmark. Existing constructors, omitted CLI options, NULL policy and zero-initialized placement policy retain huge-page advice.

api.placement: BnGPUMoETrellisPolicy.ram_pages; copied once before publication and exposed as requested advice in BnGPUMoETrellisStats.ram_pages.
api.system_definition: Omit the huge-page advice call and inherit OS policy. Does not force4KiB pages, alter global settings, pre-touch storage or change free/ownership.
api.huge_definition: Existing best-effort platform hint over owned complete OS pages. Kernel refusal or unsupported platforms preserve allocation behavior.
api.validation: Invalid enum values fail before cache/store publication. SYSTEM placement and any explicit CLI page policy require a positive RAM cache budget.
api.abi: Consumers of the extended public placement policy/stats structs must rebuild with the updated headers.

cli.scope: Process/model setup for single requests, static batches and persistent stdio serving. No per-request override or live mutation.

architecture.page_advice_owned_by: MoE cache allocation through platform; placement copies policy and owns backend resources.
architecture.payload: Expert/cache/staging/activation payload limits and layouts unchanged; fixed policy/reporting metadata follows existing sizeof-based application quotes and metadata exclusions.
architecture.session_and_lease_lifetime: Request-local mutable state, cache pins, all-consumer drains, cancellation/retry and idle retention unchanged.

performance.interpretation: The prior fixed source-cache-warm study rejected blanket advice removal: skipping it reduced first-visit throughput36.4%, while revisit/token-latency gates passed. This integration makes the choice explicit without changing that measured default. Earlier filesystem-cold/first-touch stalls remain unisolated; SYSTEM is an operational alternative, not a universal speedup or latency guarantee.

reproduction.environment: CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID,BN_CUDA_DEVICE=0; native LD_PRELOAD/LD_LIBRARY_PATH unset. GLM compatibility retains the exact mapped13.10 cuBLAS pair.

limitations: Declared adapted DeepSeek F16 CUDA profile for new product options; four-family compatibility is not four-family performance qualification.
Advice is best effort; SYSTEM follows current OS policy and does not guarantee physical page size or bounded first-touch latency.
Public C policy/stats structs have changed; rebuild consumers. No request state or payload layout changes.
No new throughput, vLLM parity, sustained SLO, CUPTI stall-attribution or exact physical-device-peak claim.
Matched filesystem-cold setup behavior, sustained native offload serving, folded/decode joint execution and broader CPU/Metal/performance qualification remain open.
